0022600219.text: Boston, playing its 12th game of the season, comes in at 9-2, first in the Atlantic and the East, with a four-game winning streak, a 4-2 road record, and a 9-1 mark over its last ten, though Paul George is out with an illness after averaging 22.0 points and 30.1 minutes per game this season. Toronto is 5-5 after 10 games, sits fourth in the Atlantic 3.5 games back and sixth in the East, and has lost its last game, with Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture), Scottie Barnes (groin soreness), and Trayce Jackson-Davis (illness) out, while Collin Murray-Boyles (illness) and Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) are day-to-day. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Celtics won the 2025-26 series 4-0, including a 115-101 win in Boston on April 5, 2026.
